## Dispatch order · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-27T00:42Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26179, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26179" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`), and the audit it comes from (#26184 comment 6425678185, Part A, § objectstack-data); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26179` on that branch, based on a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26179 --file=F` (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Maintainer's words (triage seat thread, 2026-10-26, verbatim, quoted in the card body): 「包括 skills 需要更新吗？ai在写元数据应用的时候会知道用吗」, then after the triage reading 「立卡」. Triage first grade 6419206885 on this card: `documentation` · `priority:p2` · `domain:skills` · `area:access` (⛔ not a claim). The batch anchor 6425930271 on #26184 adds the sequencing with #26297 (same file). The card's 「Wanted」 1–4 is the whole scope; the business reason (a lock for everyone vs a lock per role and stage) is what the teaching must make an AI author choose correctly.

### Scope and tier

File surface: `skills/objectstack-data/**` only — the files the card names plus the package's `evals/*.json` and, if the package carries one, `references/_index.md` (run `pnpm gen:skill-refs` if the index is generated; read `package.json` scripts). `skills/**` is a PUBLISHED surface on the governed register ⇒ the whole PR is **Tier H**: it stays a draft; the seat runs the independent `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review; the maintainer's hand (or an authorized APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` / `hotlong`) lands it. ⛔ You never ready, arm or enqueue it. `dispatch-gates --tier` for `skills/**`: MANDATORY ceiling tier with no one-line exit — that is why your thread runs at the tier it does.

`os-dev.md` 290–291 bind: the PR body reports TWO readings, the whole-file before/after line count of every changed `.md` file and the whole-package before/after (the sum over `SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`), and the default is to REFUSE a small feature written large: teach each row in the fewest lines that an AI author needs, pay additions inside the package where a stale or duplicated line exists, and remove nothing beyond the stale lines the card names. Package reading at dispatch: package 1927 lines (SKILL.md 465, references/_index.md 73, data-hooks 998, examples-objects 197, lint-rules 52, seeds 142) + rules/**/*.md 1778; rules/security.md 220; evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json 45 lines.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at dispatch (seat's subagent, 2026-10-27 00:36Z): **holds.**
1. `rules/security.md` (220 lines): 0 hits for `field permission`, `editable`, `row condition`; its 3 `when` hits are prose about permission sets and RLS, not the field-entry `when`. The spec: `when` on a field entry at `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:973`, its `.describe()` at 916 with the two refusal sentences (blank `when`; `when` beside `readable: false`).
2. The docs anchor the card names exists: `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx#row-conditioned-edit-locks-when` (one heading hit), cited from `access-recipes.mdx:87` and `protocol/objectql/security.mdx:264`. `references/_index.md`: 0 hits for `row-conditioned` — item 4 is a one-line pointer.
3. The choice rule (item 2) is the card's centre: a lock for everyone = `validation`; a lock that depends on who edits = field permission `when` on that set; never both for one need. Write it as a rule line, then the example, then the boundaries (edit only, same-object fields, pre-image on update, locks and never grants) — in that order, and in the fewest lines an AI author needs.
4. Eval (item 3): 0 hits for `editable` / field permission in `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`; the contract prompt's expected output names `when` on the finance set's field entries with `readable: true` and NO validation rule locking the fields for all users.

### Card-specific clauses

- Every new teaching gets an eval prompt in the package's `evals/*.json` (`hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`) in the file's existing shape; `pnpm check:skill-docs`, `pnpm check:skill-refs`, `pnpm check:skill-examples` green (read `package.json` for the exact script names; if a name differs, run the one that exists and say so).
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26179`, then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial (the skill teaches keys the protocol already carries), then the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的; this is a Tier H PR, so 需要你做的 names the one action: approve, or 「Merge when ready」), then `## What changes`, `## Tests`, `## Acceptance notes`, `## Verification` with log readings folded into details/summary blocks. `skip-changeset` in `pr_create`'s `labels` (the skills packages carry no `package.json`; nothing is released). Name nothing beside `#26179` with a closing keyword; other card numbers appear only with zero verbs beside them.
- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26179`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- Serial: PR #25640 (version packages) touches line 1 of every `skills/*/SKILL.md` (frontmatter version); do not edit that line. **Same-file sequencing (triage 6425930271):** #26297 (membership keys, `ownerMayEdit`, create-only seed columns, position-to-set binding) also edits `rules/security.md`; the seat dispatches #26297 AFTER this PR lands — do not take its rows. Open PR #26244 (`seedFile(path)`) adds one line to `references/_index.md`; if your item-4 index pointer lands near it, expect a trivial rebase.
- Commit trailers: the model-free pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them; ⛔ no model name anywhere in the commit or PR.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26179 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations`, `line_budget` (per `.md` file before/after and the package total before/after) and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 with the PR number, head sha and the report's key points; keep your thread open through the review (a FAIL comes back to you).
